summary: Banco BBVA Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting a routine regulatory approval. Argentina's central bank (BCRA) issued Resolution No. 148, making no objections to María Soledad Duro Ruiz serving as a director, as appointed by the annual shareholders' meeting. The filing contains no financial terms, transaction structure, or special-situation activity. It is a standard corporate governance disclosure under Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers. No deal mechanics, advisor involvement, or strategic implications are present. This is not a special situation; it merely confirms a director appointment and BCRA clearance.
